title: Vestrum: Learning the Verification, Retrieval and Structure of Agent Harnesses from a Few Long Episodes
abstract: arXiv:2609.33822v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent harnesses decide what the model retrieves, decomposes, remembers and verifies, and most people use harnesses that are pre-built and fixed, such as Claude Code or a published memory system. Harness optimizers rewrite their own harness code rather than editing pre-built systems, and they learn from tens to hundreds of tasks, while long-horizon work offers a handful of episodes, each hundreds of tool calls long. We present Vestrum, which improves existing harnesses component by component. It reads full raw traces, states each failure as a recognizable class, and changes the one component where the error arose (a self-verification, a retrieval view, a decomposition step or a memory operation). Each change targets a failure that recurs across tasks of the same kind. Before anything runs, a generalization filter refuses changes that copy facts from the development tasks. translated_title: Vestrum：从少量长回合中学习智能体框架的验证、检索与结构
translated_abstract: 智能体框架决定了模型检索什么、如何分解任务、记住什么以及如何验证，而大多数人使用的是预先构建且固定的框架，例如 Claude Code 或已发布的记忆系统。现有的框架优化器会重写自己的框架代码，而不是修改预构建的系统，并且它们需要从数十到数百个任务中学习；而长时程工作只能提供少数几个回合，每个回合包含数百次工具调用。我们提出了 Vestrum，它逐组件地改进现有框架。它读取完整的原始轨迹，将每个失败表述为可识别的类别，并只修改错误产生的那个组件（自我验证、检索视图、分解步骤或记忆操作）。每项修改都针对同类任务中反复出现的失败。在任何内容运行之前，泛化过滤器会拒绝那些从开发任务中复制事实的更改。Vestrum 从一到十个长开发回合中学习。
tldr: Vestrum 能够从仅一到十个长回合中逐组件地改进现有智能体框架：通过读取完整轨迹将失败归类为可复现的失败类别、只修改出错的组件（验证、检索、分解或记忆），并利用泛化过滤器拒绝复制开发任务事实的更改以防止过拟合。
en_tdlr: Vestrum improves existing agent harnesses component by component from only one to ten long episodes, by reading full raw traces, targeting recurring failure classes in the single faulty component, and using a generalization filter that rejects changes copying facts from development tasks.
